summary: BriaCell Therapeutics Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 1,449,300 common shares at $3.25 per share, targeting gross proceeds of approximately $4.71 million. The offering price represents a roughly 10.7% discount to the May 29, 2026 Nasdaq closing price of $3.64. ThinkEquity LLC serves as exclusive placement agent on a reasonable-best-efforts basis, and the company will bear all costs. The offering is conducted under General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3, limiting sales to one-third of public float. This is a routine capital raise with no special-situations trigger.
